description: This Java class defines the CorrectiveAction entity for a defect management system, including fields such as defect reference, description, owner, due date, status, and timestamps for creation and update. It maps to the 'corrective_actions' table and has relationships with other entities like Defect.

classes.name: CorrectiveAction
classes.description: Entity class representing corrective actions linked to defects, with attributes such as description, owner, due date, and status, along with automatic timestamp management.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the corrective action.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of the corrective action.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the corrective action.

methods.name: getOwner
methods.description: Retrieves the owner responsible for the corrective action.

methods.name: setOwner
methods.description: Sets the owner responsible for the corrective action.

methods.name: getDueDate
methods.description: Retrieves the due date for completing the corrective action.

methods.name: setDueDate
methods.description: Sets the due date for the corrective action.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of the corrective action.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the current status of the corrective action.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp when the corrective action was created.

methods.name: getUpdatedAt
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp when the corrective action was last updated.
